title: Numeric rank question with checkbox - Row based
code:
<checkbox 
  label="RANK1"
  ss:questionClassNames="disableMobileAccordion">
  <title>Question for Rank.</title>
  <comment>[res INS_M]</comment>
  <row label="r1">1</row>
  <row label="r2">2</row>
  <row label="r3">3</row>
  <row label="r4">4</row>
  <row label="r5">5</row>
  <row label="r6">6</row>
  <row label="r7">7</row>
  <row label="r8">8</row>
  <row label="r9">9</row>
  <row label="r10">10</row>
  <col label="c1" ss:colClassNames="None">None</col>
  <style label="Checkbox_Linked_Rank" arg:col="c1" arg:max="5" arg:none="None" name="question.after"><![CDATA[
<script>
$ (function(){
  var col = "$(col)" || "c1";       // rank column class
  var none = "$(none)" || "None";   // checkbox column class
  var max = parseInt("$(max)",10) || 5;
  var ranks = {};

  function $colInputs(){ return $ ("td."+col+" input[type=text]"); }
  function $noneChecks(){ return $ ("td."+none+" input[type=checkbox]"); }

  function rebuildRanks(){
    ranks = {};
    for(let i=1;i<=max;i++) ranks[i]=0;
    $colInputs().each(function(){
      let v = parseInt($ (this).val(),10);
      if(!isNaN(v) && v>=1 && v<=max){
        if(ranks[v]){ $ (this).val('').removeClass('clicked'); }
        else { ranks[v]=1; $ (this).addClass('clicked'); }
      } else $ (this).removeClass('clicked');
    });
  }

  // Initialize
  $colInputs().prop("readonly",true).addClass("clickToRank");
  rebuildRanks();

  // Checkbox → enable/disable click state
  $noneChecks().off("change").on("change",function(){
    let $cb = $ (this),
        $row = $cb.closest("tr"),
        $txt = $row.find("td."+col+" input[type=text]");

    if($cb.is(":checked")){
      $txt.addClass("clickToRank");
    } else {
      let old = parseInt($txt.val(),10);
      if(!isNaN(old) && old){
        $txt.val('').removeClass('clicked');
        $colInputs().each(function(){
          let n = parseInt($ (this).val(),10);
          if(!isNaN(n) && n>old) $ (this).val(n-1);
        });
      }
      $txt.removeClass("clickToRank clicked");
    }
    rebuildRanks();
  }).each(function(){ $ (this).trigger("change"); });

  // Click-to-rank logic
  $colInputs().off("click").on("click",function(){
    let $this = $ (this),
        $row = $this.closest("tr");
    if(!$row.find("td."+none+" input[type=checkbox]").is(":checked")) return;

    let cur = parseInt($this.val(),10);

    if(!isNaN(cur) && cur){
      let old = cur;
      $this.val('').removeClass('clicked');
      $colInputs().each(function(){
        let n = parseInt($ (this).val(),10);
        if(!isNaN(n) && n>old) $ (this).val(n-1);
      });
      rebuildRanks();
      return;
    }

    rebuildRanks();
    for(let i=1;i<=max;i++){
      if(!ranks[i]){
        $this.val(i).addClass('clicked');
        ranks[i]=1;
        break;
      }
    }
    rebuildRanks();
  });
});

</script>

<style>
td.$(col) input[type=text] {
  width: 41px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  background: #f2f2f2;
  color: #999;
  font-size: medium;
  border: 2px solid #ccc;
  font-weight: bold;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
td.$(col) input.clickToRank {
  background: #fff;
  color: #000;
  border-color: #888;

title: Input_Clear_By_Question_ALL
code:
<style label="Input_Clear_By_Question_ALL" cond="0" arg:bqn="" arg:qn="" name="question.after"><![CDATA[
<script>
$ (document).ready(function () {
    const targetInputs = "$(bqn)".toLowerCase().split(",").map(s => s.trim());
    const rows = $ ("#question_$(qn) tr");

    rows.each(function () {
        const $row = $ (this);
        const checkbox = $row.find("input[type='checkbox']");
        const numberInput = $row.find("input[type='number']");
        const textInput = $row.find("input[type='text']");
        const selectInput = $row.find("select");

        let isUserClickingCheckbox = false;

        // Detect manual checkbox click (mousedown used to distinguish user-triggered)
        checkbox.on("mousedown", function () {
            isUserClickingCheckbox = true;
        });

        function clearIfChecked() {
            if (checkbox.is(":checked")) {
                if (targetInputs.includes("number")) numberInput.val("");
                if (targetInputs.includes("text")) textInput.val("");

                if (targetInputs.includes("select")) {
                    selectInput.each(function () {
                        const $sel = $ (this);
                        if ($sel.find('option[value=""]').length > 0) {
                            $sel.val("");
                        } else if ($sel.find('option[value="-1"]').length > 0) {
                            $sel.val("-1");
                        } else {
                            $sel.prop("selectedIndex", 0);
                        }
                        $sel.trigger("change").trigger("chosen:updated");
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        // Initial load: if checkbox already checked
        clearIfChecked();

        // Standard change handler
        checkbox.on("change", function () {
            if (isUserClickingCheckbox) {
                isUserClickingCheckbox = false;
                return;
            }
            clearIfChecked();
        });

        // Handle checkbox clicks on <td class="clickableCell">
        $row.find("td.clickableCell").on("click", function () {
            setTimeout(clearIfChecked, 50);
        });

        // Auto-uncheck checkbox when number input is changed
        if (targetInputs.includes("number")) {
            numberInput.on("input change", function () {
                if ($ (this).val().trim() !== "") {
                    checkbox.prop("checked", false).trigger("change");
                }
            });
        }

        // Auto-uncheck checkbox when text input is changed
        if (targetInputs.includes("text")) {
            textInput.on("input change", function () {
                if ($ (this).val().trim() !== "") {
                    checkbox.prop("checked", false).trigger("change");
                }
            });
        }

        // Auto-uncheck checkbox when select is changed
        if (targetInputs.includes("select")) {
            selectInput.on("change", function () {
                const selectedVal = $ (this).val();
                if (selectedVal && selectedVal !== "" && selectedVal !== "-1") {
                    checkbox.prop("checked", false).trigger("change");
                }
            });
        }
    });
});
</script>
]]></style>

<style label="colsumF" cond="0" arg:Frow="" arg:fromCols="" arg:sum="100" arg:toCol="" name="question.after"><![CDATA[
<script>
$ (document).ready(function () {
    var qn = ${jsexport()};
    var uid = qn.uid;
    var rows = qn.rows || [];
    var cols = qn.cols || [];

    var targetRowLabels = "${Frow}".trim();
    var applyToAllRows = targetRowLabels === "";
    var rowLabelList = applyToAllRows ? rows.map(r => r.label) : targetRowLabels.split(",");

    var sourceColLabels = "${fromCols}".split(",");
    var targetColLabel = "${toCol}";
    var sumLimit = parseFloat("${sum}") || 100;

    // Map col labels to indices
    var sourceColIndices = [];
    var targetColIdx = null;
    cols.forEach(function(col, idx) {
        if (sourceColLabels.includes(col.label)) sourceColIndices.push(idx);
        if (col.label === targetColLabel) targetColIdx = idx;
    });

    if (targetColIdx === null || sourceColIndices.length === 0) {
        console.warn("Column labels not found.");
        return;
    }

    // Loop over all rows to apply logic where needed
    rows.forEach(function(row, rowIdx) {
        if (!rowLabelList.includes(row.label)) return;

        // Collect inputs for this row (across the source columns)
        var $sourceInputs = $ ();
        sourceColIndices.forEach(function(colIdx) {
            $sourceInputs = $sourceInputs.add($ ('#ans' + uid + '\\.' + colIdx + '\\.' + rowIdx));
        });

        var $targetInput = $ ('#ans' + uid + '\\.' + targetColIdx + '\\.' + rowIdx);
        $targetInput.prop("readonly", true).css("background-color", "#ededed");

        function updateSum() {
            var total = 0;
            sourceColIndices.forEach(function(colIdx) {
                var val = parseFloat($ ('#ans' + uid + '\\.' + colIdx + '\\.' + rowIdx).val());
                if (!isNaN(val)) total += val;
            });

            var result = sumLimit - total;
            if (result < 0) {
                $targetInput.val(result);
                $targetInput.css("background-color", "#fdd"); // light red
            } else {
                $targetInput.val(result);
                $targetInput.css("background-color", "#ededed"); // grey
            }
        }

        $sourceInputs.on("input change keyup", updateSum);
        updateSum();
    });
});
</script>

title: Auto adjust the width of all numeric box based on range
code:
<style cond="1" name="question.after"><![CDATA[
<script>
$ (function () {
    var qn = ${jsexport()};
    var minValue = qn.minValue || 0;
    var maxValue = qn.maxValue || 9999999999;
    var maxDigits = String(Math.abs(Math.floor(maxValue))).length;

    var $container = $ ("#question_" + qn.label);

    $container.find("input[type='number']").each(function () {
        var $input = $ (this);

        // Set numeric attributes
        $input
          .attr("min", minValue)
          .attr("max", maxValue)
          .attr("maxlength", maxDigits)
          .attr("inputmode", "numeric")
          .attr("pattern", "[0-9]*");

        // Remove non-digit chars and limit digits while typing
        $input.on("input", function () {
            let v = $ (this).val().replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, maxDigits);
            $ (this).val(v);
        });

        // Validate on blur
        $input.on("blur", function () {
            let v = $ (this).val();
            if (v === "") return;

            let num = parseInt(v, 10);
            if (num < minValue || num > maxValue) {
                // alert("⚠️ Value must be between " + minValue + " and " + maxValue + ".");
            }
        });
    });
});
</script>
]]></style>
